# The `IRNormalizer.cpp` File Reference

<p>This file implements the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/anonymous-irnormalizer-cpp-/irnormalizer">IRNormalizer</a> class which aims to transform LLVM Modules into a normal form by reordering and renaming instructions while preserving the same semantics. <a href="#details">More...</a></p>

## Description {#details}

<p>This file implements the <a href="/web-llvm/docs/api/classes/anonymous-irnormalizer-cpp-/irnormalizer">IRNormalizer</a> class which aims to transform LLVM Modules into a normal form by reordering and renaming instructions while preserving the same semantics.</p>


<p>The normalizer makes it easier to spot semantic differences while diffing two modules which have undergone different passes.</p>
